data.item: Expected credit losses on loans and advances Loans and advances to customers comprise a significant portion of the Group’s total assets. The estimation of expected credit losses (ECL) on loans and advances to customers requires management’s judgment in the assumptions that are applied in the models used to calculate ECL. We evaluated the appropriateness of the methodology applied by management in the estimation of expected credit losses for consistency with IFRS 9.
